method: For every actual axe-incomplete native navigation text node: inspect actual computed foreground and nearest opaque ancestor background; calculate WCAG sRGB relative-luminance contrast; record ancestor opacity/filter, viewport rectangle and elementFromPoint center ownership; save viewport PNG for visual inspection. No axe rule was disabled or result overwritten.
limits: Nearest-background calculation and a center hit test corroborate this captured state; they do not establish every glyph pixel, every screen location or assistive-technology usability. Viewport screenshots must be inspected separately. Axe incomplete findings remain in original artifacts.
